Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single native 16x16 Minecraft Farmer's Delight Refabricated HANDHELD ITEM sprite: wooden rolling pin.
Input image 1: Farmer's Delight iron knife, reference for diagonal handheld composition, small pixel dimensions and transparency ONLY, no metal blade. Input image 2: Italians Delight cheese grater, reference for coherent Minecraft tool pixel art outline/readability.
Create one wooden rolling pin item icon, like a Minecraft sword sprite: diagonal from bottom-left to top-right, isolated on a genuinely transparent background. The rolling pin has a broad smooth wooden cylindrical central barrel with two short narrow wooden handles at opposite ends along the same diagonal. Lower-left handle is the held grip; upper-right handle is visible and shorter due to perspective. It is a rolling pin, not a bat, not a shovel, not a rolling pastry scene.
Style: exactly 16 by 16 logical square pixel cells, enlarged without smoothing. Dark warm brown single-pixel outline, muted medium oak body, pale honey light along upper-left edge, deep brown lower-right edge, one or two restrained grain marks only. Body is roughly 8 cells long and 4 cells wide; handles are about 2-3 cells long and 1-2 cells wide. The silhouette occupies about 14x14 of the square with one logical pixel padding to avoid clipping.
Constraints: all object pixels fully opaque with solid flat colors; all outside pixels truly transparent. No translucent halo, no semi-transparent pixels, no antialiasing, no blur, no gradient within any logical cell. No extra object, background color, labels, text or watermark. Coherent with Farmer's Delight handmade wooden utensils and Minecraft vanilla swords. Simple legible silhouette at the actual final 16x16 size.
